quest.title: Static Views, Part 2
quest.description: As more treasure was found through the "mailbox," the "seed" collected long ago in The Chasm begins to vibrate...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! The Aranara world is truly marvelous... Just looking at a painting would lead you to the treasure...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now, we've found the locations of all the paintings! Paimon wonders where the Aranara who made these treasure maps is...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, there's that painting with many Aranara in it. We didn't find any treasure there...
(Something seems to be vibrating slightly in the bag.)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Find the vibrating item.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Is this... the seed we found in The Chasm?

choices.text: Seems like it's leading us somewhere...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... That might be it! Let's keep an eye on the seed in case it vibrates again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe it could be a trapped Aranara! Or perhaps there's something like an Aranara treasury? And this seed is the key?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Paimon thinks it wants to go somewhere! Let's keep an eye on the seed in case it vibrates again!

talks.objective: Find the last place according to the vibration of the seed and the content of the picture

dialogues.text: Eek! It's the Golden Nara! There is the taste of the wind, the taste of earth, and the taste of Aranara!
Golden Nara has figured out the Ararakalari of Arayama?
How dreadful! Obstructions are useless, anyone can break in, and the "happy nest" of Araminali will be "broken!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, don't worry, we mean no harm.

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: What does "no harm" mean? Do you mean "no greed"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Um... Paimon guesses so! {NICKNAME} and Paimon are on Aranara's side. We want to be Aranara's good friends.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon is gluttonous, but not bad in nature.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! That's technically not wrong, though...

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: Aranara's best friend... The Golden Nara smells like Aranara, a familiar smell, but I haven't smelled it for a long time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ah, by the way, that strange seed! {NICKNAME}, show the seeds to Araminali. Maybe he knows something.

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: Uhh! He is thirsty! He needs to drink a lot of water before he can change back to what he was. Come... there's a lot of water here. Let him drink enough to recover.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You put the seed in the water...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wow! The seed has become an Aranara! We found it, "the trapped Aranara"! You see, is Paimon right, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: I can't believe "the trapped Aranara" does exist...

response.speaker: Araminali
response.text: It's Aranimba! Unlike Araminali, Aranimba likes to travel around. Before, he would draw the scenery he saw from afar and send it back to Vanarana, but later...

response.speaker: Aranimba
response.text: Later, Aranimba went to a very hard and dark place, with little dirt, but a lot of stones... Under the soil, there was little grass and few trees, but a lot of mushrooms!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... Sounds like The Chasm. But, Aranimba, as an Aranara, traveled so far that he even left Sumeru...

response.speaker: Aranimba
response.text: Yes! It was a long way, and dangerous. Aranimba met the dark and dangerous Nara! However, Aranimba was protected by Aramuhukunda, and turned into a seed and "got away with it."

response.speaker: Aranimba
response.text: Now Aranimba is back safely, thanks to Golden Nara and White Floaty.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #It's {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

response.speaker: Araminali
response.text: #Yes! Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, Aranara's friends!

response.speaker: Aranimba
response.text: #Araminali is Aranimba's "good friend," so Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon are also Aranimba's "good friends". Aranimba gets it now!

response.speaker: Aranimba
response.text: Aranimba is going to leave, this time, not only painting, Aranimba will send back "gift" to Araminali, put it in the "chest."

response.speaker: Araminali
response.text: All the "chests" here belong to Araminali. Araminali is the owner of the "treasure chests."

response.speaker: Araminali
response.text: For good friends of Aranara who helped a lot of Aranara... Aranara will be "grateful," and will put the "treasure" into the "chest."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So the chest was empty!?

response.speaker: Araminali
response.text: Aranara knew everything about Vana when they were born, but when "chests" were born, they were empty! Araminali doesn't know why.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't understand too...

response.speaker: Araminali
response.text: #...When Araminali has filled the "treasure chests," Nara {NICKNAME} can open it. Sometimes Nara {NICKNAME} will cheer with "Oh yeah" and sometimes sigh with "Ah..." just as the green Nara does.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why bother? Araminali and Aranimba can directly give us what you're about to put in the treasure chests as the payment.

response.speaker: Araminali
response.text: #Araminali knows that the green Nara likes to go into the cave or in the house and open the "treasure chest." Nara {NICKNAME}, and Paimon, don't like it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... It's not like Paimon doesn't like it... It feels like... there is an inexplicable attraction?

response.speaker: Araminali
response.text: Well, Nara likes "treasure chests," and so does Araminali. Araminali allows the good Nara who had helped Aranara to open the "treasure chests."

response.speaker: Araminali
response.text: Vana has a lot of Aranara, some in need of help, and some want to play with Nara. Nara who realizes their wishes is Aranara's friend.

response.speaker: Araminali
response.text: Such Nara can open the "treasure chests" prepared by Araminali.

response.speaker: Aranimba
response.text: So Aranimba should leave now, to fill the "treasure chests."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey? But didn't Aranimba just come back? Are you leaving again? You are really in a rush... like running from a fire with the headwind...

response.speaker: Aranimba
response.text: Eek! It's nice to have wind, but not fire. Getting too close to the fire makes Aranimba thirsty again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, Paimon means, how could Aranimba be in such a hurry? Aranimba could stay for a while and catch up with Araminali.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Araminali, you haven't seen Aranimba for a long time. Don't you have a lot to say to Aranimba?

response.speaker: Araminali
response.text: Aranimba is the Aranara that will never stop so Aranimba can't be the owner of the "treasure chests."

response.speaker: Araminali
response.text: Regarding the whereabouts of Aranimba, as long as Vana knows, wind knows, flowers and grass know, Araminali will know.

response.speaker: Araminali
response.text: So, it's fine. Don't need to say much. Araminali will listen so long as Aranimba wants to say.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Um... Is this Aranara's friendship? If it were Paimon, Paimon would have a lot to share with {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Aranimba
dialogues.text: #Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, for bringing Aranimba back. The water in Vanarana is the best! And Aranimba is ready to go in no time.
